caption: The drawing depicts a single, oval-shaped bottle or flask with a short, narrow neck, positioned vertically at the center of the composition. The bottle is rendered in shades of blue-green and teal, creating a glass-like or ceramic appearance. On the front surface of the bottle, there is a decorative design in relief showing a cornucopia, or horn of plenty, filled with various fruits and leaves. These elements are also shaded in tones of green and teal, with some areas featuring subtle highlights and shadows to indicate depth and texture. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the bottle as the sole subject of the drawing. In the lower right area of the image, there is a small red signature or stamp reading "Hal Blakeley."
title: Flask
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
